_schema.note: Phase 10 per-roast sensory IDEAL. LABEL CONCEPT REMOVED (2026-05-21 — blueprint docs/PHASE10_SENSORY_REFOUNDING.md §0): for a fixed bean+roast+brewer there is a single 'good', not N co-equal flavor targets — so the v4 multi-label islands (balanced/acid-forward/sweet-body/coarse-modern/tim) are dropped. Layer 2 target = ONE 6-axis sensory IDEAL per roast; axes = acidity/sweetness/body/bitterness/astringency/roast in models.sensory.SENSORY_AXES order. Each IDEAL = predict_axes(**anchor_brew). Confidence tiers: medium_light = user ⭐5 feedback cup (Tier A — re-derived 2026-05-22 from the user's logged 'impeccable' brew, replaces the earlier Hoffman literature anchor; n=2 consistent ⭐5 cups); light = user tim feedback (re-derived at Phase 10 Step 4 through the new thin Layer 1 models/layer1.py; still provisional — tim is not a Layer 1 calibration anchor); medium / moderately_dark = deterministic placeholders (predict_axes at medium_light's reference brew point + roast offset). Filename labels.json + module models/labels.py keep their (now-misnomer) names until Step 5 rewrites the scoring chain. After Step 3 the old scoring chain (models/scoring.py, models/labels.py:ideal_abs, diagnose_anchor.py, tests/) is stale until Step 5/7 — expected Phase 10 transitional state. Detail: docs/PHASE10_STEP3_LABELS.md.

fields.ideal: 6 sensory axis target intensities (acidity/sweetness/body/bitterness/astringency/roast). Scale = CATA detection frequency, nominally [0,1]; do NOT sum to 1 — independent intensities, not mass fractions. Bullseye for the Step 5 sensory-space distance score.
fields.anchor_brew: the Layer 1 point {tds,ey,roast,dial} the IDEAL was derived from via predict_axes(). Traceability / reproducibility / Step 4 thin-Layer-1 calibration reference. NOT a scoring field.
fields.seed: provenance + confidence tier of this roast's IDEAL.

light.seed: user tim ⭐4 feedback recipe (Tim Wendelboe Nordic light-roast style), RE-DERIVED at Phase 10 Step 4 through the new thin Layer 1 (models/layer1.py) — tim ⭐4 recipe (light, 100°C, dial 3.7, 60s, 25g, XL 400ml) → TDS 1.1868 / EY 16.75. This replaces the Step 3 value (TDS 1.413 / EY 19.88, old Layer 1); the new thin Layer 1 reads the same recipe lower (60s is a short immersion → only ~75% of equilibrium). STILL PROVISIONAL: tim is not a Layer 1 calibration anchor (Layer 1 is anchored only on the medium_light Hoffman plain-immersion recipe), so light's recipe→(TDS,EY) mapping carries the uncalibrated E_MAX_ROAST_FACTOR['light'] prior. The n=3 tim bracket still ranks correctly by sensory distance (⭐4 0.000 < ⭐3 0.033 < ⭐2 0.055).
light.description: 淺焙（Nordic 真淺焙 / Tim Wendelboe 風）。roast 軸為各焙度最低、酸質為各焙度最高（明亮）。模型尚無『淺焙明亮 vs 悶』訊號 → feedback 第一精修對象。

medium_light.seed: user ⭐5 feedback cup — RE-DERIVED 2026-05-22, replaces the earlier Hoffman literature anchor (TDS 1.23). Source = the user's logged 'impeccable' (無可挑剔) medium_light brew: 94°C / dial 4.4 / 24g / 150s / XL 400ml, recomputed through the Phase 10 Step 4 thin Layer 1 → TDS 1.354 / EY 19.92. Rationale: Hoffman's 'Brewing for Balance' recipe is a respected reference, not an objective optimum — cotter hedonic-liking data shows no single 'best' exists (liking near-flat, 1.25 spread on a ~9-pt scale across all 27 cells; consumers split into two clusters with opposite optima, TDS 1.50/EY 16.6% vs TDS 1.05/EY 20.9%). For a single-user system the authoritative target is the user's own ⭐5 cup. Confidence: Tier A — n=2 mutually consistent ⭐5 cups (the other, 93°C/4.3, sits only 6-axis dist 0.002 from this IDEAL).
medium_light.description: 中淺焙。校準在使用者實測 ⭐5 杯（94°C/4.4/24g/150s，使用者評『無可挑剔』）。相對 Hoffman 文獻杯，本 IDEAL 更酸、更苦、body 略厚 —— 此為使用者偏好，非文獻平均。

medium.seed: PLACEHOLDER — deterministic: predict_axes at medium_light's reference brew point (1.3537/19.92/dial 4.4 — the user's ⭐5 cup) with the `medium` roast offset. No anchor, no feedback. Refine when a medium-roast cup is logged.
medium.description: 中焙。佔位用 —— 無錨點、無 feedback，沿 _ROAST_OFFSET 自 medium_light 推得。

moderately_dark.seed: PLACEHOLDER — deterministic: predict_axes at medium_light's reference brew point (1.3537/19.92/dial 4.4 — the user's ⭐5 cup) with the `moderately_dark` roast offset. No anchor, no feedback.
moderately_dark.description: 中深焙。佔位用 —— 無錨點、無 feedback，沿 _ROAST_OFFSET 自 medium_light 推得。
